source: Jerry Slocum Mechanical Puzzle Collection (IU Digital Collections)
approx_entries: 31,890 records online (page states over 34,000 puzzles held)
organised_by: title, date; Slocum 10-class system (put-together, take-apart, interlocking, disentanglement, sequential, dexterity, vessels, vanish, folding, impossible)
fit: named forms; kinds (10 classes); maker ledger
notes: Largest puzzle collection; catalogue still being completed. Records carry maker, place, year. Class codes per Lilly blog, not on listing page.

source: The Puzzle Museum catalogue (Hordern-Dalgety collection)
approx_entries: about 12,000 in main catalogue; over 15,000 catalogued
organised_by: Hordern-Dalgety classification (14 main classes); search by word or catalogue number
fit: named forms; kinds; maker ledger; scenes (history)
notes: Collection moved to Panicale, Italy (2026). Classification changed 1999, some codes inconsistent. Search-driven, no full browse list.

source: Rob's Puzzle Page: classification mapping and menu
approx_entries: unknown (hundreds of puzzle pages; classification table maps Slocum 10, Dalgety 14, Hoffmann 10)
organised_by: puzzle class and subclass; mapping across four schemes
fit: kinds; named forms; maker pointers
notes: Best kinds map for physical mechanism (twisty families, packing, burrs, sliding, disentanglement). Also links to designers and vendors.

source: Nob Yoshigahara Puzzle Design Competition entry lists (PuzzleWorld)

organised_by: year; each entry gives designer, goal, materials, classification, images
fit: named forms (designer-titled puzzles); maker ledger (designers); scenes
notes: Yearly entry pages are fetchable; the searchable archive on baxterweb returned zero rows when fetched, so harvest the year pages.

source: PuzzleWorld (Categories, Designers & Craftsmen, Articles, Books)
approx_entries: unknown (several hundred collectors; designer and craftsman pages)
organised_by: puzzle category; designer and craftsman
fit: maker ledger (designers, craftsmen); kinds
notes: Fetched front page only; sub-pages not opened. Site says major updates stopped, so newer designers are missing.

source: International Puzzle Party (puzzleparty.org)
approx_entries: IPP26 to IPP43 listed (2006 to 2026); exchange history search exists

source: TwistyPuzzles.com Museum
approx_entries: 13,054 matches on search page (site states 13,753 puzzles)

organised_by: alphabet by manufacturer

source: Wikipedia: Category Jigsaw puzzle manufacturers

organised_by: alphabet by manufacturer

source: Puzzle Master Inc (Canada) browse

fit: maker ledger (brand and designer facets); named forms; kinds

source: Mr Puzzle Australia (archive of puzzles sold)

fit: named forms (IPP exchange puzzles with designer, maker, edition size); kinds
notes: Shop closed 21 Dec 2023, archive kept. Entries give designer, maker, year and number made, useful for exchange puzzles.

notes: Gives the working vocabulary for puzzle boxes. Product codes like H2101 encode step count. Maker (製造元) sort exists but is not shown.

source: JIGSAW CLUB 立体パズル (ジグソークラブ)
approx_entries: 553 three-dimensional puzzle items; over 6,000 jigsaws shop-wide
organised_by: type (球体, クリスタル, キャスト, クムクム, ルービックキューブ, アクスタ), piece count, piece size, maker
